verdict.rationale: Multiple first-party sources show natural-language operation: Link CLI examples ('Buy me this book from Stripe Press', 'What did I spend on dining this month?'), MCP server tools letting agents interact with the Stripe API via prompts, and one-prompt integration builds for MPP. However, several of these flows are gated (private preview, human-approval-required for stripe_api_write actions, 24h expiry) and geographically limited, and community feedback flags sparse end-to-end documentation for how NL-driven flows resolve. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that NL commands reliably complete the full purchase/refund lifecycle without developer intervention, and broader GA availability beyond preview/US-limited regions.
